message.content:
The most visited market in New York City is **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It’s the largest and most frequented farmers‑market in the city, drawing roughly 1 million visitors each year. The market operates Monday–Saturday (closed on Sundays) and offers a wide variety of fresh produce, meats, cheeses, baked goods, and artisanal products from local growers and producers. Its central location in Union Square, combined with its long history (established in 1976), makes it a staple destination for both locals and tourists.
